This is original audio for a cozy dark-fantasy comedy, 2D quarter-view castle-defense game. It must be new material, not an imitation of any artist, franchise, existing song, or copyrighted melody.

Compose an original instrumental game soundtrack lasting about 120 seconds. A 132 BPM D minor late-wave high-risk battle theme for defending a demon castle: deep war drums, urgent low strings, hammered dulcimer, restrained brass, crooked occult woodwinds, and a rising two-minute pressure arc. Share the normal battle palette but be clearly denser and more urgent without becoming a boss march or exhausting wall of sound. Keep the arrangement readable under frequent combat sound effects. No vocals, spoken words, choir syllables, or recognizable samples. Build a coherent arc without a hard ending. Keep the opening and final two seconds texturally compatible so they can be crossfaded into a seamless loop.
